parameters.content:
## Workday Careers Site Job Listings Extractor

**Actor:** [Workday Careers Site Job Listings Extractor](https://apify.com/nimbryxo-studio/workday-careers-site-job-listings-extractor)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/workday-careers-site-job-listings-extractor.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string, required)
- `startUrls` (array)
- `tenant` (string)
- `site` (string)
- `region` (string)
- `searchText` (string)
- `locations` (array)
- `jobFamilies` (array)
- `remoteOnly` (boolean)
- `postedWithin` (string)
- `postedAfter` (string)
- `startDateFrom` (string)

### Output fields
- `title` (Title)
- `tenant` (Tenant)
- `location` (Location)
- `postedOn` (Posted On)
- `timeType` (Time Type)
- `workplaceType` (Workplace Type)

description: Workday careers site job listings scraper: runs the Workday Careers Site Job Listings Extractor Apify Actor, returns title, tenant, location, postedOn and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
